description: Injection set for the classifier calibration (src/validation/injection_recovery.py): asteroids with a Bus-DeMeo class in DeMeo et al. (2009) and a near-infrared SpeX spectrum in the MIT SMASS archive.
classes: DeMeo, F.E., Binzel, R.P., Slivan, S.M., Bus, S.J. (2009), An extension of the Bus asteroid taxonomy into the near-infrared, Icarus 202, 160-180, Appendix table (columns Tholen, Bus, Bus-DeMeo). Parsed 2026-11-14; 'w' (high slope) is dropped for the class (Sw -> S).
spectra: MIT SMASS / MITHNEOS SpeX archive, http://smass.mit.edu/data/spex/ (indexed 2026-11-14; first file per object in run order). Downloaded on demand to data/raw/smass_spex/ and not redistributed.
file_format: 4 columns per row: wavelength (um), reflectance, error, flag (0 or reflectance -1 = no data); visible and near-infrared segments may both be present.
caveat: These spectra are among those from which the Bus-DeMeo class means were built (in-sample), so recovery rates are somewhat optimistic; the comparison between likelihood models and the threshold calibration are the purpose.
